description: Defines the AAudioStreamParameters class with getters, setters, and utility functions for audio stream configuration parameters in the Android AAudio API.

classes.name: AAudioStreamParameters
classes.description: Represents configuration parameters for an audio stream, including device ID, sample rate, format, buffer capacity, direction, usage, content type, spatialization, privacy, session ID, channel mask, hardware specs, and related utility methods.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID associated with the audio stream.

methods.name: setDeviceId
methods.description: Sets the device ID for the audio stream.

methods.name: getSampleRate
methods.description: Returns the sample rate of the audio stream.

methods.name: setSampleRate
methods.description: Sets the sample rate of the audio stream.

methods.name: getSamplesPerFrame
methods.description: Returns the number of samples per frame.

methods.name: getSharingMode
methods.description: Returns the sharing mode of the stream.

methods.name: setSharingMode
methods.description: Sets the sharing mode of the stream.

methods.name: getBufferCapacity
methods.description: Returns the buffer capacity in frames.

methods.name: setBufferCapacity
methods.description: Sets the buffer capacity in frames.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction (input/output) of the stream.

methods.name: setDirection
methods.description: Sets the direction of the stream.

methods.name: isPrivacySensitive
methods.description: Checks if the stream is privacy sensitive.

methods.name: setChannelMask
methods.description: Sets the channel mask and updates samples per frame accordingly.

methods.name: calculateBytesPerFrame
methods.description: Calculates bytes per frame based on format and samples per frame.

methods.name: copyFrom
methods.description: Copies parameters from another AAudioStreamParameters instance.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the current parameter state for debugging.
